messages.author: 33dc9c6d026ee296
messages.subject: cannot login to shinyapp.io
parts:
Hello,

I'm homer.shinyapps.io.  From time to time I deploy an app, but it has been a few months since I actually logged in to shinyapps.io.

Today I attempted to log in but have been unable to do so (email or password considered incorrect).  I clicked the "Forgot Password" link and had the usual emaill sent to my Inbox, followed the link in the email and reset my password (to what I believed the old password to have been in the first place).  When I use the password I don't get to my account:  instead I'm directed to an Account Setup page.

But I don't want a new account -- i want to manage my existing shiny apps, configure the shinyapps package on a new computer, etc.

What information can I provide so as to be able to log in again?

Homer
